calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-01-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for both Change of Name of and an Adult, and Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner, Miss-Geneva Glynis World, was present in pro per, placed under oath and examined.
Petitioner, Miss-Geneva Glynis World, was present in pro per as Guardian Ad Litem for and with the minor, Haven Sebastian World.
Joshua Orellana was placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication filed today, April 1, 2008.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Miss World.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Haven Sebastian Orellana World.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
